# ABC7 Los Angeles

> > ABC7 Los Angeles (KABC-TV) is Southern California's leading local news source covering breaking news, investigations, weather, and community stories across Los Angeles and the region.

ABC7 Los Angeles delivers comprehensive coverage of Southern California news, from investigative journalism through its 7 On Your Side team to breaking stories about public safety, natural phenomena, community development, and entertainment. The station serves Los Angeles, San Bernardino County, and surrounding areas with local reporting on crime, emergencies, environmental events, and cultural happenings.

## Key Topics

- ABC7 Los Angeles / KABC-TV
- 7 On Your Side Investigations
- Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD)
- Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD)
- Southern California Weather & Natural Phenomena
- FBI Investigations
- Death Valley National Park
- Wildflowers & Superblooms
- Community Development & Housing
- Public Safety & Emergency Response
- Crime & Homicide Investigations

- Missing Persons Cases
- Entertainment & Hollywood Events
